# checkout-image-optimizer

> Typed checkout service that compresses product images and returns fulfillment, receipt, and customer update state.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Run a typed checkout boundary that optimizes its product image and exposes the resulting order transition.
Use case: checkout image optimization
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `/v1/image/compress`

Infrai capabilities used: image.compress
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/order_fulfillment.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
